class.name: GamepadGlyphProvider

method.name: _get_glyph
method.description: Returns the texture for [param input], an input slot such as [method InputRouter.button_input] returns, as drawn for [param family], an [enum InputRouter.PadFamily]. Return [code]null[/code] when there is none.

method.name: get_glyph
method.description: Calls [method _get_glyph]. Returns [code]null[/code] if it is not implemented.
